objective: Falsify four distinct spot-only mechanisms under one shared-account, point-in-time and cost-aware framework. Do not search until a winner appears.

evidence_phases.name: HISTORICAL_FEASIBILITY
evidence_phases.use: data/implementation feasibility and fixed-rule diagnosis only

cost_model.primary: Pool fee embedded in exact-input follower quote; separately add network L1/L2 or base/priority fee, quote-to-inclusion slippage/impact and empirically observed failure/expiry allowance.
cost_model.stress: Double observed network fee and slippage/impact components, plus one failed-transaction fee per 20 attempted broadcasts; do not double-count pool fee already in quote.
cost_model.unknown_cost_action: Cannot qualify as execution-ready; report historical price simulation separately.

hypotheses.mechanism: Copy public spot demand from independently selected wallets only if edge survives follower delay and costs.
hypotheses.universe: Point-in-time tokens at least180days old with a qualified USDC route,30complete days, median daily DEX volume >=1,000,000USD and $20 quote impact <=10bps. Thresholds are eligibility, not optimized alpha features.
hypotheses.wallet_selection: Monthly trailing90day WALLET_SCORING_SPEC gates; ProfitScore>=70 and CopyabilityScore>=70; related wallets clustered to one vote.
hypotheses.entry: Three independent eligible wallets buy the same token within6hours; copy at first qualified quote60seconds after third vote.
hypotheses.sizing: Lower of20% equity,25quote units and size whose planned stop loss plus all-in cost is <=0.5% equity.
hypotheses.exit: Earliest of two contributing clusters net-selling in6hours, three-ATR trailing on completed1h bars, or14day time stop.
hypotheses.risk: Independent risk engine may exit/veto; wallet signal cannot widen stop or increase size.
comparators: single-wallet copy reported but not selected
specific_acceptance: At least50% of gross positive PnL remains after removing top3 winners
No token contributes more than50% of net PnL
Next-block result alone cannot qualify candidate

hypotheses.mechanism: Use independently selected wallet accumulation only to confirm/veto existing corrected ATR-volatility entries.
hypotheses.baseline: Existing corrected ATR plus volatility filter; same exit and sizing.
hypotheses.wallet_selection: Same monthly wallet cohort and exclusions as H1.
hypotheses.entry: An otherwise-valid baseline entry is allowed only if at least two independent eligible wallet clusters are net buyers over trailing24hours and cohort qualified buy notional exceeds sell notional. No wallet flow can create a new baseline signal.
hypotheses.exit: Unchanged corrected ATR trailing/risk exit; smart sells are reported as a diagnostic, not used in primary exit.
specific_acceptance: Incremental net PnL above S0 at primary and stress costs
Does not improve solely by zero trading
Report entries blocked, winning entries lost and losing entries avoided
reject_if: Wallet cohort selected using future returns
Fewer cycles because data missing rather than deliberate veto

hypotheses.mechanism: Temporary short-horizon price pressure reverts in highly liquid pairs after exact execution costs.
hypotheses.data_gate: Complete event-level swaps or one-minute bars plus exact-input quote/cost reconstruction; SCALPABILITY_SPEC score>=75.
hypotheses.entry: On completed5m bar: z-score of close minus trailing1h VWAP over trailing2h deviations <=-2; current volume >=1.25x prior1h mean; close >=0.99x completed4h EMA-equivalent anchor; expected distance to VWAP >3x all-in round-trip cost. One position only.
hypotheses.sizing: Risk <=0.25% equity to1.5ATR stop, capped at20quote units and reserve preserved.
hypotheses.exit: First of z-score >=-0.25/VWAP recovery,1.5ATR stop, or30minute time stop. No averaging, grid or reentry in same30minute window.
comparators: no-cost diagnostic only as unattainable bound
same rule without cost gate for attribution
specific_acceptance: Target win rate70-75% reported but not required if PF>=1.8
Worst1% trade loss and longest losing streak within registered risk budget
At least50% of months with activity are net positive
No single day contributes more than25% annual net PnL
reject_if: Primary5m result nonpositive after stress costs

hypotheses.mechanism: Hold the strongest absolute and cross-sectional major spot trend, otherwise cash.
hypotheses.network: Base first; no bridge/cross-network switching in primary test.
hypotheses.universe: At each weekly cutoff: token age>=180days, trailing30day complete data, median daily DEX volume>=1,000,000USD, qualified USDC route and $20 impact<=10bps. Universe membership is persisted point in time.
hypotheses.entry: Top score only if90d return>0 and close above completed120d SMA; otherwise cash.
hypotheses.exit: Weekly leader change, absolute filter failure, corrected ATR trailing stop or account risk halt. No atomic asset switch; sell then later qualified buy.
comparators: prior ROT90 reported as seen-data control
specific_acceptance: Beats cash and existing ATR-volatility on net return without higher drawdown
No single asset contributes more than60% net PnL
Universe and ranking reproducible at every cutoff
reject_if: Performance exists only in one asset or year

multiple_testing.DSR_or_PBO: Only if effective trial-count inputs are complete; otherwise UNKNOWN
